text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! Trainer <username>, 
this Goshiki Shuntaisai was truly 
splendid!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As such, Lady Azuma has bestowed an 
additional request upon us. 
Would you hear our petition?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
We wish to record the sight of Lady <chrname> 
and the others mastering their rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
That record will surely serve as 
nourishment 
for the horse girls who will bear the 
mantle 
of the Goshiki Shuntaisai twelve years 
from now.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
A guiding light… for when they find 
themselves in doubt.
choice_data_list: Just like how we were taught, right?
Just like how we were taught, right?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. This time, it is you who shall 
become 
the history from which future horse girls 
will learn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, though the Goshiki Shuntaisai had 
come to an end, 
we decided to continue our Shuntaisai 
Program Rehearsal 
for just a little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the next generation――for the horse 
girls of tomorrow.
